last_scene.summary: After Arlequino's second successful Ой-ся performance and declaration of an unprecedented concert, senior city guard Targ approached because a crowd of thousands would require official coordination. Targ brought Arlequino to Borga, a large horned beastman who controls major training grounds. Borga offered a proving concert at the small combat yard tomorrow: venue available free from 18:30, concert at 19:00, free admission. If Arlequino independently draws and holds a strong crowd without disorder, Borga will personally approach higher authorities about access to the large military assembly field. Borga explained local norms: avoid childish flattery; show what warriors do rather than merely praising them; Carrion may be praised and even joked about, but portraying him as weak/cowardly is dangerous; noisy audience challenges are normal; do not promise what cannot be delivered. Arlequino privately tested several songs for Borga and Targ: 'Ночь перед боем' (Borga judged it strong and dark, about fear and the price of victory; suitable later in the set, not as opener), 'Штиль' (judged able to silence a rowdy crowd), 'Пиво' (made both men laugh; judged highly effective for mass participation), and 'Медведь' (story of a bear transformed into a human, identity split between beast and man; especially resonant in Eurazania). Exact copyrighted lyrics are not stored. These were private rehearsals, not public performances, so no income. Rena remains at the inn and did not witness any of this.
last_scene.continue_from: T+128 ~17:12 inside Borga's training-ground administration building. Arlequino has just finished the private performance of 'Медведь' for Borga and Targ. Tomorrow's free trial concert is scheduled at the small combat yard: preparation access 18:30, start 19:00. Success may earn Borga's support for a much larger venue; no audience with Carrion is secured yet. Personal cash 20g34s16c. Stop before Arlequino's next meaningful choice.
